### Added
- **`mcp-kubernetes.mcpServer`: the bundled mcp-kubernetes registers as a member of muster's `kubernetes` family, or not at all** (giantswarm/agent-platform#403). With `managementCluster: <name>` the connectivity chart renders the `MCPServer` the way agent-platform-mcps renders every management cluster's: `<name>-mcp-kubernetes`, labelled `muster.giantswarm.io/management-cluster: <name>`, with `spec.family {name: kubernetes, instanceArg: management_cluster}`. A single-installation deployment (the agentlab) gets the fleet's `x_kubernetes_<tool>` tools, `management_cluster: <name>-mcp-kubernetes` selecting it (muster offers a family's members by their `MCPServer` names). With `enabled: false` it renders no CR, and an `agent-platform-mcps.mcpServers` entry does the registration without a duplicate. The default, the family-less singleton `mcp-kubernetes`, is unchanged. The meta chart drops the block from the values forwarded to the mcp-kubernetes chart. `make verify-mcp-kubernetes-registration`.
